assumptions.choice: Use StochasticFull.percD as Full %K and StochasticFull.percDSlow as Full %D.
assumptions.reason: Backtrader exposes the unsmoothed fast %K as percK; for Stochastic Full (14,3,3), percD is the fast %K smoothed by 3 periods and therefore is the conventional Full %K, while percDSlow is its 3-period signal smoothing.
